1849-2105-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1849-2105-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2105-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

574-7084-7885.easyPrerequisites:
Down in the Valley's second chapter ability has resolved.
You control a land.
574-7084-7885.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-7084-7885.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2872-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2872-3469-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

654-1809-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-1809-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-1809-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Returned Pastcaller and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1981-2292-2415-5933.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2228-4153.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2228-4153.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Hapatra and Resourceful Defense.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Hapatra trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
2228-4153.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

648-5879-6854.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
648-5879-6854.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-5879-6854.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield by any method.
Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Walking Archive equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Fractal.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, losing the game.

1462-2034-4679-7747.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1806-2060-3967-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1061-7334-7679.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
1061-7334-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using The Neutrinos.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

4228-5928-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
4228-5928-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker, triggering the ability given to it by Bear Umbra, untapping all lands you control.
Holding priority, activate a land other than Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Balduvian Trading Post's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1806-2060-2921-4772-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

248-1869-5231.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Berserker with haste.
The token Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Berserker.
The nontoken Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Berserker trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Berserker token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Berserker from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3054-4050-7316.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-7316.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1012-3967-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-3967-4871-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6753-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4659-5354-7044.description:
Cast Glider Staff by paying {2}{W}.
When Glider Staff enters, it triggers, airbending Magnetic Snuffler
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Glider Staff, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Magnetic Snuffler from exile by paying {2}.
When Magnetic Snuffler enters, it triggers, returning Glider Staff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3750-7020-7025.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-7020-7025.description:
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering Avatar Roku, adding six {R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ozai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-7020-7025.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Avatar Roku infinitely to give your red creatures infinite power.

339-677-2292-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a slime counter on it

789-2073-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
789-2073-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station and Gutter Grime.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater

1719-3784-6657.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

2059-5663--108.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control a Village Bell-Ringer token.
2059-5663--108.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Village Bell-Ringer token.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
2059-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.

1020-1594-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2730-4871-5006.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2034-2730-4871-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

643-4275-4698.notablePrerequisites: Avatar of Woe does not have summoning sickness.
643-4275-4698.description:
Activate Avatar of Woe by tapping it, destroying target creature.
When the creature dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3946-4935-5449.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

654-683-1541-5220-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment or token.
654-683-1541-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Tenacious Tomeseeker, adding {R}.
When Tenacious Tomeseeker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Tenacious Tomeseeker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Tenacious Tomeseeker from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token to its Bargain ability, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times, untapping the Treasures.
Tenacious Tomeseeker enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4050-4424-4956.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Disruptive Pitmage, adding {U}.
When Disruptive Pitmage dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Disruptive Pitmage from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Disruptive Pitmage's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

4050-4498-4776.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
4050-4498-4776.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, adding {B}.
Repeat until each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

656-2399-4314.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Colfenor and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

724-1636-2034-5010.notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{B}{R}.
724-1636-2034-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
Golgari Thug dies, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard .
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{B}{R}.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Golgari Thug from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile this turn, and dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Golgari Thug from exile by paying {1}{B}.
Golgari Thug enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1355-4896.notablePrerequisites:
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other enchantments.
{W} or
1355-4896.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

678-3180.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
